item.title: 14-week public consultation launched over speed limits
item.description: A consultation on a Speed Limit Review has been launched by the Department for Infrastructure (DfI). The 14-week public consultation began on Wednesday, January 14, and will close on April 22.

item.title: Arlene Foster: 'AI is 'frightening indeed' and carries serious risks'
item.description: Arlene Foster has warned that while artificial intelligence brings huge opportunities, it also carries serious risks that must be addressed through proper regulation.

item.title: Council calls on British Justice Secretary to step in over hunger strikers
item.description: Fermanagh and Omagh District has voted by majority to write to the British Secretary of State for Justice, David Lammy, calling on him to step in and negotiate over Palestine Action prisoners currently on hunger strike.

item.title: MP highlights high fuel costs facing people in rural Fermanagh
item.description: Fermanagh and residents are facing pressure from high fuel costs, a reality highlighted by Jim Shannon during a House of Commons debate on 7 January.

item.title: Christians Against Poverty launches ‘Break the Debt Blues’ campaign
item.description: Enniskillen Presbyterian Church, which partners with debt help charity, Christians Against Poverty (CAP), is offering free debt help and Money Coaching in 2026 to help people beat the winter blues and take control of their finances, particularly following the costs and...

item.title: Omagh's Rachel realises her dream of becoming a firefighter
item.description: Today, 24 new Wholetime Firefighters officially graduated from Northern Ireland Fire & Rescue Service (NIFRS), including Omagh woman Rachel McKeown.

item.title: Busy Donegal road closed overnight after man in his 80s injured in collision
item.description: A busy Donegal road remained closed overnight after a man in his 80s was seriously injured in a road traffic collision.

item.title: Warning over traffic delays as priest's funeral to take place
item.description: Drivers in Omagh have been told to expect delays throughout this afternoon because of the funeral of Fr. Eugene Hasson.

item.title: Community group in North Fermanagh receives grant to modernise hall
item.description: Bannagh Community Project has received a grant of £5,282 from the National Lottery Community Fund to support the modernisation of Bannagh Hall.

item.title: 'Very upset family' appeal for help after pet dog goes missing
item.description: An appeal has been made in search for a dog that has gone missing in the Gortin Forest area.
